title: After upgrading to 3.2.0.1 it is not possible to connect to a new pod (Omnipod Dash)
symptom: After upgrading to AAPS 3.2.0.1, connecting to a new Omnipod Dash pod fails with a 'Generic error: java.security.InvalidKeyException: Banned public key' error. The user can connect to a new pod with version 3.1.0.3, then upgrade to 3.2.0.1 and everything works, but direct connection with 3.2.0.1 fails.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. It is suggested that the issue may be phone-specific (Xiaomi F21 Pro) or related to a specific OS version, but no definitive cause is confirmed.
fix: The thread suggests several workarounds: resetting the phone to factory state, disconnecting all BT devices except BYODA, disabling background apps, uninstalling and reinstalling AAPS, and for the Xiaomi F21 Pro specifically, flashing a different (Russian) version of the phone's firmware. However, no single fix is confirmed as the resolution.
evidence_quote: The solution is to burn a new version to the device The Russian version and all based on it work without problems
